summary.name: GPT Image 2.5 Generator
summary.one_liner: An independent browser tool for generating and editing images with OpenAI's GPT Image 2.5 model family, choosing between the Flare and Sunburst models, using site credits.
use_cases: Creating social media images from text prompts
Editing a reference photo's background or materials
Exploring poster and room design ideas
Producing 1K, 2K or 4K images for print or large display
summary.what_it_does: The page offers text-to-image generation and image editing with reference images, using GPT Image 2.5 in either Flare (for quick everyday work) or Sunburst (for demanding detail and precise edits). Users pick an aspect ratio and a 1K, 2K or 4K output, and the page lists credit costs of 6, 10 and 16 credits per image for both models. Up to 16 reference images can be added for editing. Generation requires an account with enough credits; examples and prompt preparation are viewable without signing in. The page states this is an independent site, separate from the ChatGPT app, and that no public developer API is included in the plans.
notable: Choice of Flare (speed) or Sunburst (fine detail and precise edits) models, with identical credit costs
Up to 16 reference images for editing
1K, 2K and 4K output with credit cost shown before generating
Independent site; no ChatGPT subscription or own API key needed
caveats: Generating or editing requires an account and purchased or granted credits; plans are Basic, Pro and Studio with monthly or annual credit grants
No public developer API is included in the plans
Larger resolution does not guarantee perfect text or fine detail; results need inspection
